notes.title: Chickenhare & his friends - the unstoppable trio
notes.notes:
[p]As [b]Chickenhare[/b] and his companions are about to return to the big screen with [i]Chickenhare & the Secret of the Groundhog[/i], a brand-new chapter of their story is being written: for the very first time, our heroes of feathers, fur, and scales leap into a virtual universe.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593223/bb7fd31c0cea903e28515b3e66f34ba401fff34a.png"][/img][/p][p]And what a universe it is! Far from limiting the imagination, their unique personalities and extraordinary abilities became the guiding star in the game’s design. Every level, every puzzle, and every battle was carefully crafted to highlight this unlikely trio, where each hero’s strengths are essential to moving forward.[/p][p][/p][p]🐇 [b]Chickenhare[/b] – heir to the [b]King of Featherbeard[/b] and half-rabbit, half-chicken – uses his long ears and feathers to glide across chasms and reach places that were once out of reach.[/p][p]
🥋 [b]Meg[/b], martial arts champion, dives into the fray with unstoppable energy: fast, fearless, and inventive, she can take on multiple enemies at once… sometimes with rather surprising methods![/p][p]
🐢 [b]Abe[/b], at last, reveals a strength no one expected. Behind his shell – usually a refuge for his cynical humor and moments of panic – hides colossal power. Able to smash barricades and withstand flames, Abe transforms his so-called weakness into a weapon, proving that even the most cautious can become indispensable.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593223/210bd9934c76053185d15715f938a1e5e42752d3.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks to this complementarity, players can switch between heroes at the press of a button. Solving a puzzle, crossing an obstacle, or defeating an enemy is never limited to a single solution: freedom is total, and everyone is invited to find their own way forward.[/p][p]This is why [i]Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard[/i] offers far more than just a platforming game: it’s a true adventure to share, full of humor, camaraderie, and wonder—where each hero shines in their own way.[/p]

notes.title: A real treasure awaits!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Try to win a treasure estimated to be worth $200,000 with the video game [i]Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard[/i]![/b][/p][p]
You read that right: thanks to [i]Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard[/i], the bravest and most attentive adventurers can take part in a real-world treasure hunt![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593223/c24cd24771ecf384441ad5ac2bc80008d854f1f5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Treasure hunting lies at the heart of the game. N-Zone has prepared a grand surprise for all adventurers and treasure seekers: from the very beginning of development, [b]the studio integrated a real-world treasure hunt into the game experience![/b] By following clues hidden both in-game and on the official game’s website, players will have the chance to take part in a real-life treasure hunt. The ultimate prize for the successful treasure seeker is a golden feather adorned with gems, comparable to the one featured in the game, and a genuine gold ingot. The value of these two items combined is estimated to be approximately [b]$200,000[/b].[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="daIV3VMMW8g;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Get ready to face every challenge and uncover every clue hidden in the game and on the official website, because only the most persistent adventurers will succeed in discovering the legendary Golden Feather.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Adventure, at the heart of the franchise[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Adventure is the DNA of [i]Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard[/i] and the entire franchise. Drawing on its experience in video games and large-scale treasure hunts, studio N-Zone chose to extend the virtual journey into the real world, offering a unique experience where video games and reality meet.[/p][p]The date is set: the treasure hunt begins on[b] October 14, 2025[/b], the very day the game launches. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593223/6eb814f3ba5993faa5f6a4e40128d6ccdf064d74.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]An original story in the Chickenhare universe[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]In this brand-new adventure, Chickenhare, accompanied by his loyal friends Abe and Meg, must face the evil Spiking-Beard, determined to unleash chaos after stealing the Golden Feather, a legendary artifact and kingdoms’ protector of peace.[/p][p][/p][p]Step into the shoes of the three heroes to solve puzzles, explore colorful worlds, and stop Spiking-Beard before it’s too late. Action, platforming, heartfelt humor, and friendship will define this epic quest for the youngest and more experienced adventurers.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593223/f990932384a87541f36e5419a513f66fb2c11d99.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]A universe already beloved[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Born as a comic series, [i]Chickenhare[/i] quickly stood out with its unique mix of humor and adventure. After the animated film [i]Chickenhare and the Hamster of Darkness[/i] produced by nWave Studios, our heroes continue their journey with a second feature film planned for October 2025: [i]Chickenhare and the Secret of the Groundhog[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]With the video game [i]Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard[/i], the universe keeps expanding, promising an experience that is funny, thrilling, and family-friendly.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 [url="https://chickenhare.game"]Pre-order Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard on PlayStation 5 here [/url]and stay up to date about the treasure hunt! [/p][p]
 Pre-orders will also soon be available on Nintendo Switch and Xbox Series X/S.[/p][p]

notes.title: Accessibility: A Driving Force in Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard
notes.notes: [p]When we think of a game designed to be accessible for children, the first reaction is often: “So, it’s going to be easier, right?” After all, when you design at a child’s level, you need to strike a balance between learning and frustration, freedom and guidance — with gameplay that’s simple to grasp. But the reality is far more subtle: making a platformer accessible doesn’t mean removing challenge, depth, or difficulty.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s first and foremost about introducing difficulty the right way and making adjustments that work for all kinds of adventurers, as explained by Lucie Deschamps:[/p][p][/p][p][i]“The speed at which a puzzle is solved doesn’t depend on whether the player is a child or an adult, but rather on whether they’re used to playing games or not. The way people think, between those who play often and those who don’t (or barely do), can be very different, because it’s a different perspective. So, to make sure all types of players could succeed at puzzles, we opened up the space in those areas and added clear environmental hints on how objects function. This way, everyone can solve them if they pay attention, even if it takes longer for those less used to playing.”[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593223/4790abc3b2d6bcabcbf7622b6d9437d3c9c3733d.png"][/img][/p][p]For example, a tutorial that can be intuitively understood by both adults and kids clears visual clutter and reduces frustration, without altering the difficulty. It’s about designing the interface, choosing precise wording without infantilizing players, and carefully timing when tutorials appear.[/p][p][/p][p]As for difficulty itself, while there’s no golden rule, progression is key. In Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard, progression is both gradual and, as expected from a non–open world, linear. Théo Pottier outlines the structure:[/p][p][/p][p][i]“Each world in the game is made up of three different levels. Each level has adaptive difficulty to help the player learn the new mechanics of that world:[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Level 1:[/i][/b][i] introduction to the world + new mechanics[/i][/p][p][b][i]Level 2:[/i][/b][i] mastering those mechanics[/i][/p][p][b][i]Level 3:[/i][/b][i] increased challenge through enemies and platforms.”[/i][/p][p][/p][p]This triptych structure allows kids to learn and ease into the game without frustration, while more experienced players can still enjoy the mechanics and have a good time. After all, that’s the essence of platformers, which remain lighter than the “die and retry” mechanics of Souls-likes: here, death or mistakes aren’t designed as punishments or sources of frustration.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593223/fd43b7bec0b845746644c09f70b870d03d9f6e7f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The team also worked on rewarding players for experimenting, even if they didn’t succeed on their first try.[/p][p][/p][p][i]“The main mechanics of the three heroes were defined by how fun they were to use. Once validated, we built level elements that would react to them. There are many elements that respond to the whip (a mechanic shared across the three characters), and objects that can be broken (by Meg’s punches or Archie’s shell). With so many interactive elements spread around, every player action brings some sort of reward. This encourages players to test these mechanics on anything they can find in a level,” explains Lucie.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Through equipment like the whip, which can also serve as a grappling hook, or the unique traits of each character, the inaccessible becomes accessible — as long as the player experiments, asks questions, and seeks to understand their environment. Even a failed jump with Hopper can turn into a learning moment, thanks to his gliding ability:[/p][p][/p][p]“For Hopper, for example, a simple jump can trigger the gliding mechanic. Not only does it fit the character, but it also reduces frustration tied to jumps that require more precision,” Théo adds.[/p][p][/p][p]Guiding players is essential, but it shouldn’t overshadow gameplay itself: there needs to be room for error, experimentation, and correction — much like the 2D games of our childhood. Olivier Pignol-Guidicelli reflects on how this shaped the design:[/p][p][/p][p][i]“Where necessary, we placed several visual indicators, like arrows, in levels to guide players. In the tutorial, for example, conveyor belts were added to help players retrace their steps.”[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Playtests further refined these initial concepts, especially when faced with real player habits — kids and adults alike. In fact, playtesting with children often challenged some assumptions. Arthur Rogery recalls one striking anecdote:[/p][p][/p][p][i]“We were exploring different options for Chickenhare’s glide controls: either assigning it to the same trigger button as the other characters’ special actions, or pressing the jump button a second time in mid-air. During a playtest, we saw a child using his left hand to reach over and press the trigger, twisting his whole body to pull it off. From that moment, the decision was obvious!”[/i][/p][p][/p][p]In this case, accessibility wasn’t about simplification or lowering difficulty, but about fluidity, so that the game stayed fun and approachable for all body types.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Conclusion: Accessibility Redefines Difficulty[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The team never set out to make an “easy” platformer. They wanted a game that teaches, rewards curiosity, and grows with the player. The challenges are there, but they’re designed to be inviting rather than discouraging.[/p][p][/p][p]In short: accessible doesn’t mean effortless. It means that every adventurer, young or old, can experience this virtual journey at their own pace![/p]

notes.title: Devlog: Designing a Platformer Where Story Comes First
notes.notes: [p]When it comes to platformers, there are a few golden rules: fun gameplay, satisfying feedback (yes, that perfect coin pickup sound), clear goals, a smooth difficulty curve, meaningful rewards, and environments tailored to the challenges ahead. And often, there's a story — a red thread that ties all the levels and worlds together into a greater adventure.[/p][p][/p][p]In [i]Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard[/i], story isn’t just part of the experience — it’s at the heart of everything. The game takes place in a rich, colorful universe already known to fans of the films, but here, it’s the narrative that directly shapes the level design.[/p][p][/p][p]The movie’s thrilling treasure hunt felt like a natural fit for a video game adaptation. Our heroes have to jump, run, climb, and dodge traps at the last second — it’s a perfect recipe for a fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled platformer.[/p][p][/p][p][i]“To keep everything coherent — the story, the cutscenes, the levels, the bosses — we held regular meetings to align on what really mattered”[/i], explains Théo Pottier, game designer.[/p][p][/p][p]But beyond storytelling, fun remains the top priority — especially when the game is made for a younger audience.[/p][p][/p][p][i]“The story was our starting point, but the most important thing was to keep it fun. ‘Follow the fun’ was our rule,”[/i] says Brice Mattivi, the game’s producer.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593223/a0648d7089e35c029d177a026e92c81e96968acb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Finding the right balance was key. Hopper’s new journey across the Kingdoms had to feel true to his character and the spirit of the films, while always remembering: we’re building a game, not an interactive movie.[/p][p][/p][p][i]“At the beginning of production, we had trouble syncing gameplay — especially the level design — with the narrative,”[/i] Théo admits. [i]“To stay on schedule, we sometimes had to simplify things on the design side, which meant tweaking the story instead. It was easier to adjust than rebuilding a level.”[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Once the major elements were in place, the team went back in for a second pass — polishing the story flow and adding narrative touches wherever it made sense.[/p][p][/p][p][i]“We added small moments, cutscenes, and bits of dialogue to better reflect what’s going on in the story,”[/i] Brice adds.[/p][p][/p][p]The result? A joyful mix of narrative and gameplay, crafted with care to deliver an adventure that feels coherent, exciting, and worthy of both the film’s legacy and the imagination of our youngest players.[/p]

notes.title: Creating Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard - Finding the right tone!
notes.notes: [p]Finding the right tone in a creative process is always a delicate step. In the case of [i]Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard[/i], the challenge was even more complex, as the game is set in an already established universe—including the comics and films—which had already shaped the characters, their journeys, their personalities, and their voices. And it’s easy to fall into the trap of repeating familiar patterns. [i]“We didn’t want to imitate the film, but we wanted to respect its spirit,”[/i] explained Vincenzo Bianca, CEO of N-ZONE.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593223/74e620e461c04584383ea90b0a4dba20699eda47.png"][/img][/p][p]So how do you do that? How do you preserve the charm, humor, and optimism that define the familiar characters from the films? Three pillars: rhythm, tone, and interactions. [i]“We embraced a tone that blends adventure, humor, self-discovery, and tenderness—elements from the film—while also incorporating features unique to video games, like a faster pace and more interactions.”[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Because unlike a film, which you passively watch, a game requires player input and engagement. You have to find ways to integrate that active participation into the game’s rhythm. That means the dialogue needs to be more entertaining, more intense, and more engaging—because beyond their classic narrative function, lines in a game serve other purposes: informing, guiding, encouraging, and framing the player experience. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593223/b5f1247b4e1a08bb3d23829fec0b4b92b90d38e8.png"][/img][/p][p][i]“Every line was crafted to add nuance, speak to fans, or help move the game forward. We had the freedom to create an original story while staying true to the characters’ personalities and relationships, and that balance was achieved thanks to the open discussions we had with nWave. Those conversations allowed us to imagine new worlds and dynamics while keeping the same playful, curious, and slightly chaotic spirit,”[/i] Vincenzo Bianca added. All this, while making sure the game stays accessible to both seasoned players and young adventurers alike.[/p][p]It’s by finding that unique recipe that [i]Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard[/i] was born—both a tribute and an original story within the Chickenhare universe.[/p][p]Don’t miss our upcoming articles for more behind-the-scenes insights into the development of [i]Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard[/i]![/p]

notes.title: Chickenhare & the Treasure of Spiking-Beard - A plateformer made for everyone!
notes.notes:
[b]In Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard, you’ll step into the paws of a brave trio of adventurers: Chickenhare, Abe, and Meg. This brand-new video game invites players of all ages to jump in and share a fun-filled adventure together. And what better genre than a platformer to delight kids and grown-ups alike?[/b]

Veteran players will no doubt be reminded of the 2D and 3D platformers that defined their childhood—those nostalgic sound effects still echoing in their dreams! While Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-Beard pays tribute to those classics, it also opens the door for the next generation: with its third-person view and colorful worlds, it’s the perfect way for young gamers to explore challenges at their own pace, solve puzzles, and learn the language and mechanics of video games in a playful and welcoming environment. And if things get tricky, we’re sure an older sibling, or parent, will be ready to lend a hand!

notes.title: Deep dive into the Chickenhare universe
notes.notes:
Chickenhare is a wildly original adventure-comedy franchise that hatched from the imaginative mind of comic book creator Chris Grine. First introduced in a series of graphic novels blending quirky humor, heartfelt storytelling, and fantastical worlds, Chickenhare quickly gained a devoted fan base with its one-of-a-kind hero—a half-chicken, half-hare with a whole lot of heart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593223/6eb814f3ba5993faa5f6a4e40128d6ccdf064d74.gif[/img]

The leap from page to screen came with [i]Chickenhare and the Hamster of Darkness[/i], a CGI-animated feature film produced by nWave Studios. The film brought the beloved character and his world to life in a bold, family-friendly adventure full of action, charm, and visual flair. Its success extended the franchise’s reach, inspiring a new wave of fans and a video game adaptation that lets players jump into Chickenhare’s shoes for their own daring quests. 

The next movie, [i]Chickenhare and the Secret of the Groundhog[/i], is set to hit theaters in Europe and the rest of the World starting in October 2025, promising even bigger adventures, familiar faces, and a galaxy of new surprises.

[previewyoutube=RZIgUdME0qs;full][/previewyoutube]

With a growing universe of stories and fans, Chickenhare continues to celebrate bravery, friendship, and being unapologetically different—whether on the page, the screen, or in the game.

notes.title: ANNOUNCEMENT – ANSWER THE CALL OF ADVENTURE
notes.notes:
No rest for our heroes! As Chickenhare’s second movie prepares to hit the big screen, we’re beyond excited to announce that Chickenhare & The Treasure of Spiking-Beard is also coming soon as a game! Get ready to embark into an epic adventure where teamwork, courage, and a little bit of mischief are the keys to saving the realms. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593223/a0576777b3bdc8deed38e2b30efae5d3ece3a262.png[/img]

The kingdoms are in grave danger! Spiking-Beard and his gang are already one step ahead, racing to claim the seven legendary crystals and throw the realms into chaos. But there’s still hope! It’s up to Chickenhare, Meg, and Archie — and YOU — to outsmart Spiking-Beard, restore balance, and become the heroes the realms desperately need. 

But here’s the catch: no one can do it alone. Chickenhare’s team is strongest when they work together — and that’s where the magic happens. Archie, the skeptical yet incredibly strong Galapagos Tortoise, can smash through obstacles and clear the way. Meg’s unmatched martial arts skills make her a force to be reckoned with, even against the toughest foes (yes, including the notorious Piggy). And Chickenhare? He’s mastered his agility and jumping powers, able to reach impossible places. Jump, fight, and solve brain-teasing puzzles as a team — because together, you can tackle anything.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593223/419ec30041747ccd8e61afa9693c6748509c766c.gif[/img]

Swap between your favorite heroes in-real-time and combine their unique abilities to solve any challenges, triumph from any enemies, and make your way through vibrant environments. 

 Prepare for an epic quest where an in-game treasure hunt unfolds into a real-world adventure—culminating in a one-of-a-kind, high-value unique artifact waiting to be discovered. Stay tuned… the hunt begins when the game launches. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593223/6eb814f3ba5993faa5f6a4e40128d6ccdf064d74.gif[/img]

This isn’t just an adventure — it’s the perfect chance to share a wild ride with your family. Whether you're guiding the next generation of adventurers or teaming up with your little ones for some cooperative fun, Chickenhare & The Treasure of Spiking-Beard brings everyone together for a journey filled with excitement, laughs, and just the right amount of challenge. 

So… are you ready to answer the call of adventure? Grab your crew, sharpen your skills, and stay tuned on our social media — big surprises are coming soon!
